topics.name: Identity Registration Anchor
topics.purpose: Define the canonical registration date/time used as the stable weekly MeritCore reporting cadence anchor for an identity.

semantics.anchor_rule: Identity registration date/time is explicit and stable.
semantics.merit_rule: Recurring weekly MeritCore reporting intervals are anchored to this identity registration cadence.
semantics.change_rule: Changing profile/timezone presentation does not silently shift historical reporting buckets.
semantics.history_rule: Original registration anchor remains historical evidence.
semantics.identity_rule: Anchor belongs to exact IdentityCore identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Registration anchor has no authorization semantics.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.
